params.name: limit

params.description: Show only the smart collections specified by a comma-separated list of IDs.

params.description: Restrict results to after the specified ID.

params.description: Show smart collections with the specified title.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Show smart collections that includes the specified product.

params.description: Filter results by smart collection handle.

params.description: Show smart collections last updated after this date. (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00)

params.name: published_at_max

params.name: published_status
params.description:
Filter results based on the published status of smart collections.
                  (default: any)
                    
                        published: Show only published smart collections.
                        unpublished: Show only unpublished smart collections.
                        any: Show all smart collections.
